rounds: I usually find out about new films on TikTok or Instagram, not from trailers.
A film everybody is posting about is worth seeing, even if it looks terrible.
Influencers who get free cinema tickets can't give an honest review.
Memes about a film are better advertising than its trailer.
Trailers come out far too early: two months before the film is plenty.
If a film needs a huge social media campaign, it probably isn't very good.
I'd rather see a film on opening night than wait for the reviews.
Anyone who posts spoilers in the first week deserves to be blocked.
